Sandbox_DF_MemoirAutoFixShadowedTraits: Memoir: repair shadowed traits on login
Sandbox_DF_MemoirAutoFixShadowedTraits_t: Migration fix. Memoir recalls before 2026-08-09 could hand back a MOD trait that shares a vanilla trait's name (for example an inert stand-in "Organized" instead of the real one that grants the container bonus), and the swap was written into the character's save, so it survives relogging. With this on, every character is checked as it connects and any such trait is swapped back to the vanilla original - the whole server repairs itself over one restart. Each repair is logged to the server console and the Memoir audit. Safe to re-run and safe to leave on; turn it off if a mod on your server deliberately gives players a trait that shares a vanilla name.
Sandbox_DF_MemoirXPRestore_tooltip: Global skill-XP restore percentage (100 = full restore, 90 = 10%% off every skill, 0 = no XP). In Global mode this applies equally to every skill. In Per-Individual mode it is the fallback for any skill that has no per-skill value set (including modded skills). Traits, profession, recipes and ParanormalZ Faith always restore in full regardless of this setting. The normal recall never drops a skill below its current XP, so re-grinding still pays off.
Sandbox_DF_MemoirXPRestoreMode_tooltip: Global = the single XP restore %% above applies to every skill. Per Individual = each skill uses its own %% from the "Dragonfly: Memoir Skill XP" page (any skill left unset there falls back to the Global %%). The per-skill sliders stay visible in both modes but only take effect in Per-Individual.
